Strings.Usage:
Welcome to the Locale Emulator command line tool.
Usage: LEProc.exe path -run path [args] -runas guid path [args] -manage path -global
path Full path of the target application. guid GUID of the target profile in LEConfig.xml. args Additional arguments passed to the target application.
path Run an application with its own profile, the first global profile, or the default ja-JP profile. -run Run an application with its own profile. -runas Run an application with a global profile identified by GUID. -manage Modify the profile of one application. -global Open Global Profile Manager.
Press CTRL+C to copy this message to the clipboard.
